verdict.rationale: Pulumi's `pulumi preview --json` produces a structured JSON steps[] array (op, urn, etc.) that an agent can parse to reason about a proposed change, and this was independently verified hands-on in a local, non-interactive run without Pulumi Cloud. Documentation and CLI reference corroborate this as an officially supported flag. missing for 10: no independent third-party (non-vendor) documentation of agents actually consuming this JSON for reasoning, only a single hands-on probe.
